template <typename Key> void HeapTimer<Key>::Tick() noexcept { while (!Empty()) { if (auto& node {nodes_.front()}; node.Expired()) { const auto callback {std::move(node.callback)}; const auto key {node.key}; Pop(); try { assert(callback); callback(key); } catch (const std::exception& err) { logger_->Log( log::Event::Create(log::Level::Error) << fmt::format("Exception raised in timer's callback: {}", err.what())); } } else { break; } } }

template <typename Key> void HeapTimer<Key>::Invoke(const Key& key) { const auto idx {key_to_idx_.at(key)}; try { assert(nodes_[idx].callback); nodes_[idx].callback(key); } catch (const std::exception& err) { logger_->Log(log::Event::Create(log::Level::Error) << fmt::format("Exception raised in timer's callback: {}", err.what())); } RemoveByIndex(idx); assert(!Contain(key)); }
